description: Manual one-click update of the Ubuntu-us Claude-mem Worker and all Windows Claude/Codex/npm clients. Do not install the standalone npm package separately.
pre_install: if ($target -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { throw 'Invalid official Claude-mem version in Scoop manifest' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $updater)) { throw 'Claude-mem central updater not configured on Windows' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Central Claude-mem update failed ($LASTEXITCODE). Scoop package remains on the previous version." }
notes: UniGetUI -> Software Updates -> Scoop / claude-mem-central -> Update is the only supported manual upgrade action.
The original npm/claude-mem row stays ignored in UniGetUI to prevent local-only upgrades.
The Scoop update first runs official-package compatibility tests in GitHub Actions, upgrades the central Worker with backup/rollback, then synchronizes all local clients.
No automatic Worker upgrade, Windows scheduled sync, or automatic GitHub approval is enabled.
